+#!/usr/bin/python
+
+# (c) 2018, NetApp, Inc.
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: netapp_e_drive_firmware
+short_description: Manage NetApp E-Series drive firmware
+description:
+  - Upload E-Series drive firmware files and upgrade compatible drives whose firmware differs from the file version.
+  - Firmware files must be obtained from NetApp support for E-Series disk firmware.
+version_added: '2.8'
+extends_documentation_fragment:
+  - netapp.eseries
+options:
+  firmware:
+    description: Local paths to E-Series drive firmware files.
+    type: list
+    elements: path
+    required: true
+  wait_for_completion:
+    description: Wait for all selected drives to finish upgrading.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+    description: Skip offline or unavailable drives instead of failing.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  upgrade_drives_online:
+    description: Upgrade drives while they continue accepting I/O.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+notes:
+  - Check mode reports whether any drives need an upgrade without initiating one.
+author: NetApp
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Upgrade E-Series drive firmware
+  netapp_e_drive_firmware:
+    api_url: https://array.example.com:8443/devmgr/v2
+    api_username: admin
+    api_password: "{{ array_password }}"
+    ssid: '1'
+    firmware:
+      - /tmp/drive-firmware.dlp
+    wait_for_completion: true
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+upgrade_in_process:
+  description: Whether the initiated upgrade is still in progress when the task returns.
+  returned: always
+  type: bool
+  sample: false
+'''
+
+import json
+import os
+import time
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.netapp import create_multipart_formdata, eseries_host_argument_spec, request
+from ansible.module_utils._text import to_native
+
+
+WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 3600
+POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 5
+HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'}
+
+
+class NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware(object):
+    """Upload, select, and upgrade E-Series drive firmware."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        arguments = eseries_host_argument_spec()
+        arguments.update(dict(
+            firmware=dict(type='list', elements='path', required=True),
+            wait_for_completion=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            ignore_inaccessible_drives=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            upgrade_drives_online=dict(type='bool', default=True),
+        ))
+        self.module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=arguments, supports_check_mode=True)
+        params = self.module.params
+        self.firmware_list = params['firmware']
+        if not self.firmware_list:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='At least one drive firmware file is required.')
+        self.wait_for_completion = params['wait_for_completion']
+        self.ignore_inaccessible_drives = params['ignore_inaccessible_drives']
+        self.upgrade_drives_online = params['upgrade_drives_online']
+        self.ssid = params['ssid']
+        self.url = params['api_url'].rstrip('/') + '/'
+        self.creds = dict(url_username=params['api_username'], url_password=params['api_password'],
+                          validate_certs=params['validate_certs'])
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+        self._upgrade_list = None
+
+    def _request(self, path, data=None, method='GET', headers=None):
+        status, result = request(self.url + 'storage-systems/%s/%s' % (self.ssid, path), data=data,
+                                 method=method, headers=headers or HEADERS.copy(), **self.creds)
+        if status >= 400:
+            raise ValueError('HTTP %s: %s' % (status, result))
+        return status, result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _records(data, names):
+        """Allow the API's list response and its common named-list wrapper."""
+        if isinstance(data, list):
+            return data
+        if isinstance(data, dict):
+            for name in names:
+                if isinstance(data.get(name), list):
+                    return data[name]
+        raise ValueError('Unexpected response format')
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _value(record, names):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in record:
+                return record[name]
+        return None
+
+    def upload_firmware(self):
+        """Upload each file separately so an error identifies the offending file."""
+        for path in self.firmware_list:
+            try:
+                filename = os.path.basename(path)
+                headers, body = create_multipart_formdata([('file', filename, path)])
+                headers['Accept'] = 'application/json'
+                self._request('files/drive', data=body, method='POST', headers=headers)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upload drive firmware [%s] to array [%s]: %s' %
+                                      (path, self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+    def upgrade_list(self):
+        """Choose only compatible drives with firmware older than the supplied file."""
+        if self._upgrade_list is not None:
+            return self._upgrade_list
+
+        try:
+            _, response = self._request('firmware/drives')
+            compatibilities = self._records(response, ('compatibilities', 'firmware', 'driveFirmware'))
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array [%s]: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+        filenames = set(os.path.basename(path) for path in self.firmware_list)
+        grouped = {}
+        for compatibility in compatibilities:
+            if not isinstance(compatibility, dict):
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Invalid compatibility response.')
+            filename = self._value(compatibility, ('filename', 'fileName', 'firmwareFileName'))
+            if filename not in filenames or compatibility.get('compatible') is False or compatibility.get('isCompatible') is False:
+                continue
+            refs = self._value(compatibility, ('driveRefList', 'driveRefs', 'drives', 'driveRef'))
+            if isinstance(refs, dict):
+                refs = refs.get('driveRef', [])
+            if not isinstance(refs, list):
+                refs = [refs] if refs is not None else []
+            for item in refs:
+                if isinstance(item, dict) and (item.get('compatible') is False or item.get('isCompatible') is False):
+                    continue
+                drive_ref = item.get('driveRef', item.get('id')) if isinstance(item, dict) else item
+                if not drive_ref:
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    _, drive = self._request('drives/%s' % drive_ref)
+                    if not isinstance(drive, dict):
+                        raise ValueError('Unexpected drive response format')
+                except Exception as error:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array [%s], drive [%s]: %s' %
+                                          (self.ssid, drive_ref, to_native(error)))
+
+                if drive.get('offline') or drive.get('available') is False or drive.get('status') in ('offline', 'unavailable'):
+                    if self.ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+                        continue
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive [%s] on array [%s] is offline or unavailable.' %
+                                          (drive_ref, self.ssid))
+
+                target = self._value(item, ('firmwareVersion', 'targetVersion', 'newVersion')) if isinstance(item, dict) else None
+                if target is None:
+                    target = self._value(compatibility, ('firmwareVersion', 'targetVersion', 'newVersion', 'version'))
+                if target is None:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Firmware [%s] has no target version.' % filename)
+                current = self._value(drive, ('firmwareVersion', 'softwareVersion'))
+                if current is None:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array [%s], drive [%s] has no firmware version.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, drive_ref))
+                if current == target:
+                    continue
+                capable = self._value(item, ('onlineUpgradeCapable', 'onlineUpgradeable', 'onlineUpgradeSupported')) if isinstance(item, dict) else None
+                if capable is None:
+                    capable = self._value(compatibility, ('onlineUpgradeCapable', 'onlineUpgradeable', 'onlineUpgradeSupported'))
+                if capable is None:
+                    capable = self._value(drive, ('onlineUpgradeCapable', 'onlineUpgradeable', 'onlineUpgradeSupported'))
+                if self.upgrade_drives_online and capable is False:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive is not capable of online upgrade. Array [%s], drive [%s].' %
+                                          (self.ssid, drive_ref))
+                grouped.setdefault(filename, [])
+                if drive_ref not in grouped[filename]:
+                    grouped[filename].append(drive_ref)
+
+        self._upgrade_list = []
+        for name in (os.path.basename(path) for path in self.firmware_list):
+            if name in grouped and not any(item['filename'] == name for item in self._upgrade_list):
+                self._upgrade_list.append(dict(filename=name, driveRefList=grouped[name]))
+        return self._upgrade_list
+
+    def wait_for_upgrade_completion(self):
+        """Poll only the drives selected for this upgrade."""
+        targeted = set(ref for entry in self.upgrade_list() for ref in entry['driveRefList'])
+        deadline = time.time() + WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC
+        while targeted:
+            try:
+                _, response = self._request('firmware/drives/state')
+                states = self._records(response, ('driveStates', 'drives', 'state'))
+                if not all(isinstance(state, dict) for state in states):
+                    raise ValueError('Unexpected drive status response format')
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array [%s]: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+            for state in states:
+                drive_ref = self._value(state, ('driveRef', 'id'))
+                if drive_ref not in targeted:
+                    continue
+                status = self._value(state, ('status', 'state', 'upgradeStatus'))
+                if status == 'okay':
+                    targeted.remove(drive_ref)
+                elif status not in ('inProgress', 'inProgressRecon', 'pending', 'notAttempted'):
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Array [%s], drive [%s], status [%s].' %
+                                          (self.ssid, drive_ref, status))
+            if not targeted:
+                break
+            if time.time() >= deadline:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array [%s], drives [%s].' %
+                                      (self.ssid, ', '.join(sorted(targeted))))
+            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        """Initiate the selected upgrades and optionally wait for completion."""
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if not upgrades:
+            return
+        body = dict(upgradeList=upgrades, online=self.upgrade_drives_online)
+        try:
+            self._request('firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade', data=json.dumps(body), method='POST')
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array [%s]: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if upgrades and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(upgrades), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import json
+
+from ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware import NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware
+from units.compat import mock
+from units.modules.utils import AnsibleExitJson, AnsibleFailJson, ModuleTestCase, set_module_args
+
+
+class DriveFirmwareTest(ModuleTestCase):
+    def firmware(self, **options):
+        params = dict(api_username='admin', api_password='secret', api_url='https://array/devmgr/v2',
+                      ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/target.dlp'])
+        params.update(options)
+        set_module_args(params)
+        return NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware()
+
+    def test_upload_uses_multipart_and_identifies_failures(self):
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.create_multipart_formdata',
+                        return_value=({'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data'}, b'data')) as multipart:
+            with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', return_value=(200, None)) as api:
+                subject.upload_firmware()
+                multipart.assert_called_once_with([('file', 'target.dlp', '/tmp/target.dlp')])
+                self.assertEqual(api.call_args[0][0], 'files/drive')
+                self.assertEqual(api.call_args[1]['data'], b'data')
+            with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=Exception('invalid file')):
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                    subject.upload_firmware()
+                self.assertIn('Failed to upload drive firmware', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+                self.assertIn('/tmp/target.dlp', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_compatibility_filters_files_and_current_versions(self):
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        compat = [dict(filename='other.dlp', firmwareVersion='B', driveRefList=['other']),
+                  dict(filename='target.dlp', firmwareVersion='B', onlineUpgradeCapable=True,
+                       driveRefList=['needs-update', 'current'])]
+        responses = [(200, compat), (200, dict(firmwareVersion='A', available=True, offline=False)),
+                     (200, dict(firmwareVersion='B', available=True, offline=False))]
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=responses) as api:
+            self.assertEqual(subject.upgrade_list(), [dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['needs-update'])])
+            self.assertEqual(api.call_count, 3)
+            self.assertEqual(subject.upgrade_list(), [dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['needs-update'])])
+            self.assertEqual(api.call_count, 3)
+
+    def test_inaccessible_drive_policy_and_online_capability(self):
+        compat = [dict(filename='target.dlp', firmwareVersion='B', onlineUpgradeCapable=False,
+                       driveRefList=['drive'])]
+        unavailable = dict(firmwareVersion='A', available=False)
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=[(200, compat), (200, unavailable)]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('offline or unavailable', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+        subject = self.firmware(ignore_inaccessible_drives=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=[(200, compat), (200, unavailable)]):
+            self.assertEqual(subject.upgrade_list(), [])
+
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=[(200, compat), (200, dict(firmwareVersion='A'))]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('Drive is not capable of online upgrade.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_upgrade_and_wait_only_track_selected_drives(self):
+        subject = self.firmware(wait_for_completion=True, upgrade_drives_online=False)
+        subject._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['chosen'])]
+        responses = [(202, None),
+                     (200, [dict(driveRef='other', status='failed'), dict(driveRef='chosen', status='pending')]),
+                     (200, [dict(driveRef='chosen', status='okay')])]
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=responses) as api:
+            subject.upgrade()
+            self.assertFalse(subject.upgrade_in_progress)
+            self.assertEqual(json.loads(api.call_args_list[0][1]['data'])['online'], False)
+            self.assertEqual(api.call_args_list[0][0][0], 'firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade')
+
+    def test_poll_failure_and_timeout(self):
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        subject._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['chosen'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', return_value=(200, [dict(driveRef='chosen', status='failed')])):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+            self.assertIn('Drive firmware upgrade failed.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC', 0):
+            with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', return_value=(200, [dict(driveRef='chosen', status='pending')])):
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                    subject.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+                self.assertIn('Timed out waiting', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_api_failures_have_operation_specific_messages(self):
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=Exception('controller unavailable')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('Failed to complete compatibility and health check.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+        compat = [dict(filename='target.dlp', firmwareVersion='B', driveRefList=['chosen'])]
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=[(200, compat), Exception('lookup failed')]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('Failed to retrieve drive information.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        subject._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['chosen'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=Exception('status unavailable')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+            self.assertIn('Failed to retrieve drive status.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, '_request', side_effect=Exception('request rejected')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                subject.upgrade()
+            self.assertIn('Failed to upgrade drive firmware.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+            self.assertFalse(subject.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+    def test_apply_reports_change_and_check_mode(self):
+        subject = self.firmware(_ansible_check_mode=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, 'upload_firmware') as upload:
+            with mock.patch.object(subject, 'upgrade_list', return_value=[dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['chosen'])]):
+                with mock.patch.object(subject, 'upgrade') as upgrade:
+                    with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                        subject.apply()
+                    upload.assert_called_once_with()
+                    upgrade.assert_not_called()
+                    self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['changed'], True)
+                    self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'], False)
+
+        subject = self.firmware()
+        with mock.patch.object(subject, 'upload_firmware'):
+            with mock.patch.object(subject, 'upgrade_list', return_value=[dict(filename='target.dlp', driveRefList=['chosen'])]):
+                with mock.patch.object(subject, 'upgrade', side_effect=lambda: setattr(subject, 'upgrade_in_progress', True)):
+                    with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                        subject.apply()
+                    self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['changed'], True)
+                    self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'], True)
